* '''Original full face''' ([[Yavin 4: Massassi War Room (V)]]): preserved in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 the first Holotable repository import, 8 July 2018]. No errata mark.

No errata mark.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-8-archive-2021-10-05-pages-1-7-extract.pdf|Official Set 8 PDF archived 5 October 2021, lossless page extract]], original page 7 (extract page 2).</ref>
* '''Errata 2, current full face''' ([[Yavin 4: Massassi War Room (V) (Errata 2)]]): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/hires/yavin4massassiwarroom.png source PNG] was authored and committed 2022-07-10T17:26:49Z; the pixel-identical [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 GIF copy] was committed 19:39:59Z that UTC day. * '''Errata 3, later partial''' ([[Yavin 4: Massassi War Room (V) (Errata 3)]]): June 2023 sheet edition. No errata mark. The Set 8 badge is larger, and type/title/game-text placement differs from the earlier partial; these are real layout changes rather than JPEG encoding noise.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-8-June-2023.pdf|Official Set 8 PDF, June 2023 edition]], page 7.</ref>
All four show the same game-text words. The absent marks on the three later image ordinals are recorded in [[Players Committee transcription errors]]. [[File:V8-L-yavin4massassiwarroom-Set8-2021-2023-partial-comparison.png|thumb|center|300px|Earlier and later published partial layouts.]]
